description: Delete one of your saved Canvas bookmarks. Only affects you. Get bookmark_id from list_bookmarks. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

bookmark_id.description: Bookmark ID (numeric string). Get it from list_bookmarks.

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.
